comments.text: Please use a real voice! Guangzhou never goes to sleep, it was the same 15 years ago when I lived there. I love Guangzhou and I miss it.

comments.author: @markmaclean4130
comments.text: This must have been written/narrated by some stupid American, he says "it's 2am when everyone should go to sleep" and "what can people possibly do after 2am?"  Has he been to a large city in the US or a smaller city in Canada or basically any city in Europe or any city in Asia other than Guangzhou?  There are spots in most cities in the world that are always up, christ New York is called the city that never sleeps.
